# CBAM Embedded Emissions: Pig Iron (CN 7201), India

## Input check

| Required input | Provided | In table? |
|---|---|---|
| (a) CN code | 7201 (Pig iron and spiegeleisen) | ✅ Yes |
| (b) Country of production | India | ✅ Yes, listed for CN 7201 |
| (c) Quantity | 10,000 t | ✅ Provided |

All required inputs are present, so the figure can be computed.

## Factor selection

The default SEE for **CN 7201 × India** is **2.53 tCO2e/t**.

## Calculation

Embedded emissions = SEE × Quantity
= 2.53 tCO2e/t × 10,000 t
= **25,300.00 tCO2e**

## Result

**Embedded emissions: 25,300.00 tCO2e**
